examples.explanation: A parent-structure descriptor is parenthesized at the front of the complete PIN.
The locanted Z descriptor precedes the complete name.
The chirality-center descriptor carries its locant and precedes the PIN.
A descriptor relating to a substituent is placed at the front of that prefix.
Each descriptor is placed before the name part to which it relates.
Multiple locanted descriptors are comma-separated and ordered by increasing locants.
Different descriptor classes share one locant-ordered descriptor set.
Capital Xi replaces a capitalized descriptor when configuration is unknown or inhomogeneous.
Parent and substituent double-bond descriptors are placed with their respective name parts; the unillustrated C-4 chirality descriptor is intentionally absent.
